Those who attacked Hindu temples are enemies of the Liberation War spirit: Quader
2021-10-17T00:12:22+06:00 | BSS, DHAKA
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/politics/news/those-who-attacked-hindu-temples-are-enemies-the-liberation-war-spirit-quader-2200156

Awami League General Secretary and Road Transport and Bridges Minister Obaidul Quader today said evil, communal forces carried out attacks on Hindu temples in a planned manner.

"No violence or problems occurred during Durga Puja in the last 12 years. This time evil, communal forces orchestrated these attacks. None of those involved with these heinous attacks will be spared," he said.

Quader made these remarks while addressing the triennial council of Rajbari district unit of AL, joining it virtually from his official residence in the capital.

Saying that those who carried out attacks on Hindu temples are enemies of the spirit of Liberation War, he urged all to unitedly resist the evil forces.

It is natural that those who cannot tolerate the country's development will become angered, he mentioned.

He said a quarter with vested interest is looking for chances time and again for carrying out violence, capitalising on the religious belief of the people.

About BNP leaders' remarks that the government is involved with the mayhem, the minister said, "The government wants to ensure stability in the country. Why will the government do this?"
